title: Bronco Raptor in the Night Studio in the Forest
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
description:
Step inside the Night Studio, where a bright giallo yellow Ford Bronco Raptor rests quietly in the warm indoor glow. Just beyond the glass, a pine forest stands under soft moonlight with quiet ribbons of mist floating between the trees. Settle in as two hours of music-only lo-fi hip hop fills the room with jazzy keys and a mellow head-nod beat. It is a peaceful space made for you to work, study, or simply relax tonight.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
